newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes up vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes up vs dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed up against the dollar on Wednesday as sellers came into the market late to shed dollar positions, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 59.27 to the U.S. currency after opening at 59.34. On Tuesday, the rupee closed at 59.36 near the Central Bank's selling rate.
The Central Bank pushed the range down by a quarter local cent and fixed on buying and selling at 58.1922 and 59.3678 respectively.
A Hatton National Bank dealer said a lot of the day's business was done at the 59.30 range after the currency moved slightly away from the Central Bank's top.
Earlier in the day, the rupee was inactive as traders preferred to hold on to dollars, sensing a depreciation of the local currency by the Central Bank, dealers said.
Overnight call money, which opened at 9.5 percent, closed at 9.38 percent with the market liquid, dealers said.
